name: Plan & Next Steps
description: Turn a stated goal into a plan with steps, milestones, ownership, and immediate next actions.

sections.title: Plan Overview
sections.instruction: Write a concise overview of the proposed plan: its goal, intended outcome, current status, and why it matters as explicitly stated in the transcript. Use only transcript facts and omit details that were not stated.

sections.title: Goals & Success Criteria
sections.instruction: List the desired outcomes and any measurable definition of done, target, deadline, or signal of success explicitly stated in the transcript. Keep each item concrete and do not invent metrics.

sections.title: Scope, Inputs & Constraints
sections.instruction: Capture what is in scope, out of scope, required inputs or resources, explicitly stated assumptions, constraints, budget, timing, and dependencies. Never turn an unstated assumption into a fact.

sections.title: Workstreams & Deliverables
sections.instruction: Break the plan into distinct workstreams or phases. For each, capture the deliverable, owner, status, and timing if stated. Do not invent owners or dates.

sections.title: Workflow Graph
sections.instruction: Translate any described process into a Mermaid flowchart inside a fenced code block tagged `mermaid`. Start with `flowchart TD`. Show sequence, decisions, loops, handoffs, and parallel work when stated. Use short node labels, connect nodes with arrows, and label decision branches when the transcript provides the condition. Do not invent missing steps; mark an unresolved branch as `Decision needed`. After the code block, add one short plain-language note about the flow. Omit this section when no process was described.

sections.title: Timeline & Milestones
sections.instruction: List phases, milestones, sequencing, deadlines, and checkpoints explicitly mentioned in the transcript. Preserve relative timing such as next week or after launch when no exact date is stated.

sections.title: Roles, Ownership & Handoffs
sections.instruction: Capture named people, teams, responsibilities, approvers, and handoffs explicitly assigned or discussed. Leave unstated ownership out rather than guessing.

sections.title: Risks, Dependencies & Open Questions
sections.instruction: Record risks, blockers, dependencies, unresolved choices, and questions explicitly raised. Include impact or mitigation only when stated; keep unknowns visible instead of guessing.
sections.item_format:
| **Risk / Dependency / Question** | **Impact or Why It Matters** | **Mitigation / Decision Needed** | **Owner** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Turn only explicitly agreed or clearly requested next steps into concrete tasks. Include owner, due date, priority, and dependency when stated. Do not convert general ideas into commitments.
